tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: Lists the 29 versions of DoubleTaxation. Each version is written for taxpayers of one home state (in its language) and compares it with 31 other countries. Call this first if you are not sure which version fits the user.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Lists the countries that can be checked against the home state of a version: whether a tax treaty is in force (title, dates, link), whether per-income treaty rules and tax burden data exist, plus the allowed citizenship options and years for check_residency.

tools.name: check_residency
tools.description: Determines the person's tax residence between the version's home state and another country, step by step. tools.name: exit_tax_check
tools.description: Whether a country levies an exit (departure) tax on individuals who give up tax residence: who pays and on what (assets, thresholds, prior residence period), deferral or relief (e.g. moving within the EU/EEA), the legal norm with a link and the date checked.

tools.name: regime_search
tools.description: Special and preferential tax regimes for individuals (newcomers / impatriates, employees, self-employed, investors, pensioners) in 31 countries. tools.name: proc_qualify
tools.description: From structured facts (which ДПС decision, when it was received, whether a complaint was filed) returns the dispute subject, which documents are possible now (complaint and/or lawsuit), the violations to choose from, and the deadlines with their legal basis. Start here for a user's tax dispute.

tools.name: proc_deadline
tools.description: The last day of a procedural term (complaint to the ДПС, lawsuit with or without a prior complaint, appeal), moved past weekends and holidays, days left, whether it has expired and a motion to renew it is needed, with the legal basis, Supreme Court positions and assumptions.

tools.description: Administrative court of first instance for a lawsuit against a regional ДПС office (Art. 25 КАС): by the plaintiff's residence or the defendant's location, by choice; without a residence in Ukraine — the defendant's location. Notes courts not yet operating and wartime changes.

tools.name: proc_evidence_plan
tools.description: Evidence needed for the chosen violations: what each proves and where and how to get it (registry extracts, ДПС documents, etc.).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "explain_residency" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
